pr_title: Implement Decode entry in Indexed images
pr_body:
Fixes #10339 in which page background images have an Indexed color space and an inverting entry `/Decode [255.0 0.0]`. `Decode` hasn't been implemented for Indexed, so wrong colors appeared.

In core/image.js I had to modify also `decodeCoefficients` and `decodeAddends` values if the color space is Indexed. Function `decodeAndClamp()` uses those values and it returns color components multiplied by `max`. (`max` is 255 when BitsPerComponent is 8.) `decodeAndClamp()` works fine if the components are in range [0, 1]. However, Indexed components are in range [0, `max`]. If `decodeAndClamp()` multiplied them again by `max`, the values would go out of range.

- PDF.js version: latest source code

## Steps to reproduce the problem:

Sorry for broken links. 
This is the first time use share of google drive, and I checked in incognito mode of chrome, these links can be viewed that time.

 I edited and fixed the broken image links.
What's the current status of this issue? Is these display problems been confirmed?

The background images have an `Indexed` color space. They also have `/Decode [255.0 0.0]` which should invert the colors of the image. In PDF.js, `Indexed` color space ignores the `Decode` entry, so colors will be wrong. For example blue and white colors are inverted in the first PDF.
https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/blob/e4d2a1604efdb4a49f29b4a593baea23e4470c36/src/core/colorspace.js#L568-L570

review_comments: Perhaps it would also be a good idea to check that the `bpc` parameter is an integer, larger than zero, in *addition* to the checks done above?
